caption: The drawing shows a round plate with a decorative floral pattern on its surface and a side profile of the plate beneath it. The plate is primarily a light yellowish color with some faint greenish patches, and it features a central motif comprising two large green flowers with red petals and circular centers, as well as three pointed leaf-like shapes at the top, partially colored green and red. The flowers are connected by green stems and have red leaves. Around the rim of the plate is a border decorated with a repeating linear and triangular motif in brown. At the bottom center of the plate, the year "1823" is written within a small banner. The side profile of the plate underneath is shaded in brown to show the plate's depth and curvature. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white.
title: Plate with Tulip and Two Flowers
